name: Cryonic-Spire
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near frozen methane lakes.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
